summary: Iteration 70 testing completed - Syndic data purge feature fully verified. 6/6 backend tests passed. All 5 frontend button state tests passed. The purge endpoint correctly handles validation (404 for invalid user, 400 for email mismatch, 'aucune ACP' message for syndics without coproprietes) and the full purge flow works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: 2. Validates user_id exists (returns 404 if not found or malformed ObjectId)
3. Validates confirm_email matches syndic's email (returns 400 if mismatch)
4. Returns 'aucune ACP' message if syndic has no copropriete_ids

5. Purges all data from collections: lots, owners, suppliers, invoices, fund_calls, mutations, journal_entries, bank_statements, bank_transactions, pcmn_accounts, expense_categories, distribution_keys, fiscal_years, coproprietes
6. Also deletes team users (gestionnaire/owner) linked to the syndic
7. Clears syndic's copropriete_ids array after purge
1. Flame icon (Flame from lucide-react) shown only for syndic users with copropriete_ids.length > 0
2. Dialog shows warning 'Action irreversible' with list of data to be deleted
4. Confirm button disabled until email matches (case-insensitive comparison)
5. handlePurge function calls DELETE /api/admin/syndic/{user_id}/purge-data with confirm_email in body
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary syndic users and coproprietes for testing, then clean up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 70 added the syndic data purge feature. The DELETE /api/admin/syndic/{user_id}/purge-data endpoint is fully functional. Frontend shows flame icon for syndics with ACPs, and the confirmation dialog requires email re-entry before enabling the purge button.

backend_purge_404_invalid_user.details: DELETE /api/admin/syndic/{user_id}/purge-data returns 404 for non-existent or malformed user_id

backend_purge_400_email_mismatch.details: Returns 400 with 'Confirmation incorrecte' message when confirm_email doesn't match syndic's email

backend_purge_no_acps_message.details: Returns 200 with 'aucune ACP' message when syndic has no copropriete_ids

backend_full_purge_flow.details: Full flow: create syndic -> create copropriete -> add data -> purge -> verify deletion. All collections purged correctly.

frontend_flame_icon_visibility.details: Flame icon (purge button) visible only for syndic users with copropriete_ids > 0

frontend_purge_dialog_elements.details: Dialog shows warning, data list, email input (data-testid='purge-confirm-email'), and confirm button (data-testid='purge-confirm-btn')

frontend_button_disabled_initially.details: Confirm button is disabled when dialog opens

frontend_button_disabled_wrong_email.details: Confirm button stays disabled with partial or wrong email

frontend_button_enabled_correct_email.details: Confirm button becomes enabled when correct email is entered (case-insensitive)
